entities.summary: Wilhelm Weinberg was a German obstetrician-gynecologist, practicing in Stuttgart, who in a 1908 paper, published in German in Jahresheft des Vereins für vaterländische Naturkunde in Württemberg, expressed the concept that would later come to be known as the Hardy–Weinberg principle.
